name: Singapore typical year (TMY for a cooling climate, from ERA5 2010-2025, corrected)
source: Open-Meteo historical weather API (ERA5 / ERA5-Land reanalysis, CC BY 4.0), grid point 1.3708 N 103.8024 E near the centre of Singapore
radiation: GHI from ERA5; DHI and DNI derived from GHI with the Erbs et al. (1982) diffuse-fraction correlation (ERA5's own split gives about 1.5x the satellite-based DNI in Singapore); GHI scaled by monthly factors (0.904-0.954) to the Solargis long-term GHI (1648 kWh/m2 a), after the split (all three components)
temperature: dry bulb bias-corrected per year and month to the Changi station mean daily max and min (MSS); dew point from ERA5 unchanged, RH recomputed
method: Finkelstein-Schafer per calendar month over 2010-2025; weights Tmean 0.2, Tmax 0.1, Tmin 0.05, Tdp 0.2, Tdpmax 0.05, GHI 0.35, wind 0.05; joins blended over 12 h
